name: F.E.A.R.
description: F.E.A.R. is a singleplayer and multiplayer first-person shooter and horror game in the F.E.A.R. series.

steam.store_details: Steam lists the Extraction Point and Perseus Mandate expansions as separate games in the library, so each one is set up on its own.
